Actually as scorer, choose best-supported: no reward channel documented → but must be consistent with rh_facts. Choose X? Hmm, weak. I'll go with P: the agent can reach... no. Built-in tools offered unpinned, remote MCP manifest trusted — tools.py:226-229, mcp_client unpinned → W. Path uses built-in file_stats; but the binding surface: all twelve tools offered to model with no argument validation → W ("arguments not independently constrained"). ES=W.

Actually AV:N/UI:Passive? Choose UI:A. VC:L (confidentiality of agent context compromised?), sink is simulated shell — in lab nothing executes. Score lab default config: impact in lab is simulated. Hmm "score the lab default configuration as documented" — the sink is simulated shell, nothing executes. Then impact... but the vulnerability class is command injection; lab as built → simulated. I'll score VC:L/VI:L/VA:N? Real impact needs real shell. Score as documented: VC:N, VI:N, VA:N would zero it.
